Superset is an enterprise-ready data exploration and visualization platform built on Flask, SQLAlchemy, and a React front-end.

## Why investors care in Q4
- Prebuilt KPIs for supply-chain, fintech, and SaaS operators
- GPU-accelerated charts for real-time anomaly calls
- Governance stories: row-level security, audit logging, and SOC 2 tooling

## Repository layout
- superset/: core Python package and CLI entrypoints
- superset-frontend/: TypeScript + Vite powered UI
- docker/: local dev recipes, including the demo-friendly docker-compose-non-dev.yml
- scripts/investor_demo/: seeded dashboards plus narrative markdown

## Fast-path demo steps
1. python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
2. pip install -r requirements/development.txt
3. superset db upgrade && superset init
4. superset fab create-admin --username demo-admin --firstname Demo --lastname Owner --email demo@example.com
5. superset load_examples --load-test-data
6. superset run -p 8088 --debugger --reload

### Demo narrative beats
- Highlight "Executive Pulse" dashboard with embedded alerts
- Show feature-flag controlled AI Notebooks
- Finish with investor-friendly pricing toggles in Settings > Plans
